title: On Ramanujan Primes for Hecke-Maass Cusp Forms
summary: For a primitive Hecke-Maass cusp form $φ$ of level $N$ with the $n$-th Hecke eigenvalue $λ_φ(n)$ and a prime number $p\nmid N$, the celebrated Ramanujan conjecture at $p$ asserts the following sharp upper bound: \[ |λ_φ(p)| \leq 2. \] In this work, we determine an upper bound for the least prime $p$ at which the Ramanujan conjecture holds for two or three distinct primitive Hecke-Maass cusp forms simultaneously.
